findings.title: R2 is outside the E96 series
findings.description: R2 prints 4.7 kΩ. The E96 mantissa list requires 4.75, not 4.7. R1 10 kΩ is on-grid.
findings.recommendation: We recommend replacing R2 with 4.75 kΩ ±1% in 0603, for example RC0603FR-074K75L.
